title: Now You See Me Now You Don't: A Framework To Detect and Reduce Proxy Capacity
abstract: arXiv:2611.25327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In regulated domains such as lending, the two most salient fairness concepts are disparate impact and disparate treatment: disparate impact is generally defined by differential rates of adverse outcomes between demographic groups, while disparate treatment is generally defined by the use of demographic information or proxies to issue decisions. There already exist established methods to quantitatively detect and mitigate disparate impact; however, there has been less research on doing the same for disparate treatment. From a practitioner's perspective, the manner in which a conditional independence test is formulated and operationalized to identify proxies is nuanced and underexplored. As Machine Learning (ML) systems increase in scope and application in regulated domains, practitioners need a defensible framework to identify proxies at scale. tldr: 该论文针对受监管领域（如贷款）中差别性对待的公平性问题，提出了一个可辩护的框架，用于大规模检测并降低机器学习模型中的代理变量能力。
